summary: **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member** **Determination of levellised generic tariff for second year of the Control Period (for FY 2025-2026) under Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024.** 1. The Commission has notified the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024, on 12.06.2024 (hereinafter referred to as "the RE Tariff Regulations"), which provide for terms and conditions and the procedure for determination of tariff of the following categories of Renewable Energy (RE) generating stations: 2. As per Regulation 7 of the RE Tariff Regulations, the Commission shall determine project specific tariff, on a case to case basis, for the following RE technologies: _1) In case of renewable energy projects for which generic tariff has to be determined as per these regulations, the Commission shall determine such generic tariff prior to the commencement of year for each year of the Control Period:_ _Provided that for first year of Control Period i.e., from 01.07.2024 to 31.3.2025, the Generic Tariff Order shall be determined upon issuance of these regulations.”_ 5. For this purpose, the Commission issued a Public Notice on 11.06.2025 along with a proposal for “Determination of the levellised generic tariff for the second year of the control period under Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024” and invited comments/suggestions/objections from the stakeholders. The last date for submission of comments/suggestions/objections was as 25.06.2024 6. In response to this public notice, written comments/ suggestions/ objections were received from the following Stakeholders: 7. The Commission has considered the comments/ suggestions/ objections of the stakeholders, and the analysis/ decision of the Commission thereon is dealt with in relevant paragraphs of this order. 12. Further, no other comments on any other parameters have been received. Hence, the Commission determines the levellised generic tariff for RE-based generating Stations for the second year of the Control period (i.e., 01.07.2025 -31.03.2026) as enclosed in Annexure-I to this Order 2. For RE projects covered under Regulation 7 of the RE Tariff Regulations, the Commission is required to determine project specific tariff. A separate petition is required to be filed for determination of project specific tariff as per Regulation 8 of RE Tariff Regulations. 3. The clause (hh) of sub-Regulation (1) of Regulation 2 of the RE Tariff Regulations defines 'useful life' in relation to project, including dedicated evacuation system, from the date of commercial operation (COD) of such project, and shall mean the following: 4. Regulation 5 of the RE Tariff Regulations specifies that the Control Period for determination of tariff for renewable energy projects (RE projects) shall be from 01.07.2024 to 31.03.2027. The proviso to this regulation specifies that the tariff determined for the RE projects commissioned during the control period, shall remain valid for the tariff period (Useful life of the project). Accordingly, the tariff determined for the second year of the control period,shall be applicable for the Projects commissioned during the period from July 1, 2025 till March 31, 2026. The said Order shall remain in effect until the Commission issues a Generic Tariff Order for the remaining control period. _“(1) The generic tariff shall be determined, on levellised basis, considering the year of commissioning of the project, for the tariff period of the project:_ 14. Small hydro project for the purpose of the RE Tariff Regulations cover those projects which are located at the sites approved by the State Nodal Agencies/ State _For determination of generic tariff and project specific tariff, loan tenure of 15 years shall be considered._ _(a) The loans arrived at in the manner indicated in Regulation 13 shall be considered as gross normative loans for the calculation of interest on loans. For project specific tariff, the normative loan outstanding as on the 1st of April of every year shall be worked out by deducting the cumulative repayment up to the 31st of March of the previous year from the gross normative loan._ _Provided that no depreciation shall be allowed to the extent of grant or capital subsidy received for the project._ 32. Regulation 17 of the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 specifies for the working capital 36. Regulation 19 of the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 specifies Operation and Maintenance _(1) Operation and Maintenance expenses shall be determined for the Tariff Period of the project based on normative O&M expenses specified in these regulations for the first year of the Control Period._ 37. The normative O&M expenses for various RE technologies specified under the relevant provisions of the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 are as under: _“(1) The Commission shall take into consideration any incentive, grant or subsidy from the Central or State Government, including accelerated depreciation benefit, availed by the project while determining the tariff under these regulations:_ _(3) In case the Central or State Government or their agencies provide any generation- based incentive, which is specifically over and above the tariff, such incentive shall neither be taken into account while determining the tariff nor be deducted by the beneficiary in subsequent bills raised by the particular Renewable energy project.”_ # 13. The detailed computations for the generic tariff for various RE technologies have been enclosed with this Order as per the details given hereunder:
title: Determination of levellised generic tariff for second year of the Control Period (for FY 2025-2026) under Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024.
